name: ide-eslint
author: lumine-code
description: ESLint language-server adapter for JavaScript and TypeScript.

serverPath.title: Server Path
serverPath.description: Absolute path to a `vscode-eslint-language-server` executable. Leave empty to use the bundled server.

features.title: Features
features.description: Which parts of the ESLint server the editor uses.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.description: Report ESLint problems in the linter.

format.title: Format
format.description: Use ESLint auto-fixes when formatting a file.

codeActions.title: Code Actions
codeActions.description: Offer fixes, disable comments and rule documentation actions.

packageManager.title: Package Manager
packageManager.description: Package manager used to locate a globally installed ESLint when the project has none.

nodePath.title: Node Module Path
nodePath.description: Optional directory from which to resolve ESLint. Relative paths are resolved from the project root.

useFlatConfig.title: Use Flat Config
useFlatConfig.description: Load eslint.config.js/mjs/cjs instead of legacy eslintrc configuration.

run.title: Validation Timing
run.description: Validate while typing or only after a file is saved.

workingDirectory.title: Working Directory
workingDirectory.description: How the server finds the directory used for ESLint configuration and plugins.

onIgnoredFiles.title: Ignored Files
onIgnoredFiles.description: Whether ESLint reports that an open file is ignored.

options.title: ESLint Options
options.description: Additional options passed to the ESLint class.

rulesCustomizations.title: Rule Customizations
rulesCustomizations.description: Override severities or fixability for matching rule names.

fixability.title: Fixability
fixability.description: Apply to every matching rule, only fixable rules, or only unfixable rules.

shortenToSingleLine.title: Shorten to One Line
shortenToSingleLine.description: Keep every reported diagnostic range on one line.

showDocumentation.title: Rule Documentation
showDocumentation.description: Offer an action that opens the documentation for a reported rule.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Fix all problems or only problems already reported by the current validation pass.

rules.title: Rules
rules.description: Optional rule patterns included in fix-all operations.
